notes: Formal/polite "თქვენ" forms; no slang or loanword colloquialisms (მესიჯი etc.)
Buttons and menu items use the verbal noun (masdar): Save → შენახვა, not შეინახე
Georgian has no capitals: English Title Case labels become plain text ("Last Updated on" → ბოლო განახლების თარიღი)
Noun after a number stays singular: "%s records" → %s ჩანაწერი. File has nplurals=1, so one form serves both singular and plural
Use „…“ for quoted text in prose; keep ASCII quotes inside code, placeholders and attributes
Odoo, Gmail, Outlook, Google, WhatsApp, QWeb, Python, JSON, XML, CSV, URL, API, IP, SMTP, IMAP, HTML, GIF, EDI stay untranslated
Keep a trailing "..." or "…" exactly as in the source
